qualifying.developer: LEAD Development / Jubail Island Investment Company
qualifying.location: Jubail Island, between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi
qualifying.launchWindow: Formal unveiling at LIVEX on 29 September 2026; developer newsroom dated 30 September. Earlier August registration/marketing existed, so this is not presented as the first-ever sales opening.
qualifying.teaser: LEAD confirms a 167-villa RIMAS collection on Jubail Island; commercial terms awaited.
qualifying.summary: LEAD Development formally unveiled RIMAS at LIVEX on 29 September 2026, with its own newsroom publishing the announcement on 30 September. The announced collection comprises 167 four- to six-bedroom villas on Jubail Island, between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island: 76 four-bedroom, 76 five-bedroom and 15 six-bedroom homes, on plots of approximately 850–1,716 sqm. RIMAS had already appeared in August registration and broker marketing; this report covers the dated official unveiling and announced villa collection, not a first-ever sales opening. Initial AED prices, payment plan, current reservation/EOI, available inventory and developer-confirmed handover remain unverified.
